races.display_title: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict: Lots with chances but DIVOT arrives at the top of his game so is taken to bag a third victory of the summer at the chief expense of Alazwar who scored under Brodie Hampson at Beverley last time. Recent Brighton scorer Wrist Art and in-form maiden Warrnambool can also play a prominent role. DIVOT ALAZWAR (IRE) WRIST ART (IRE)

races.verdict: Possible to make a case for most of these. HIS FINEST HOUR posted 2 good placed efforts in Class 4 events here for his new yard here last month and can resume winning ways in this slightly lower grade. Cosmos Raj bounced back to form out of the blue at Redcar recently and his good course record provides hope that he can build on that. Fellow Ripon specialist Poet's Dawn also has to enter calculations. HIS FINEST HOUR COSMOS RAJ POET'S DAWN

races.display_title: Ripon Yorkshire's Garden Racecourse Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict: ALMARADA PRINCE has been knocking on the door in stronger races than this at Yok lately and looks ready to win for Paul Midgley. Mister Sox , a dual C&D winner, and Educating Rita were better than the result over C&D on Great St Wilfrid day and head the dangers along with Here Forever , a lightly-raced 3-y-o who leaves the impression he has bigger performances in him. ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE) MISTER SOX EDUCATING RITA

races.verdict: FEMME FATALE has upped her game since going over 2m and is taken to defy a small rise for Lingfield, perhaps at the main expense of fellow 3-y-o Si White , who wasn't that far behind her at Lingfield. Last year's winner Regally Blonde should also be on the premises. FEMME FATALE SI WHITE (GER) REGALLY BLONDE

races.display_title: Racing Again September 19th Maiden
races.verdict: BARTHOLOMEW has been notably progressive in just 3 starts over hurdles since last seen on the Flat and almost certainly remains capable of better now reverting to this code, so he's a very appealing candidate. Dee Bee Zed went the wrong way from a successful bumper debut but is worth another chance based on the strength of his opening win. Joe Cool can have a say if bouncing back from a lesser effort, while very smart chaser Western Fold is another interesting contender. BARTHOLOMEW DEE BEE ZED (IRE) JOE COOL (IRE)
